SELECT
       /* ============================================================
          REQUEST
          ============================================================ */
       RAWTOHEX(R.REQUEST_ID) AS REQUEST_ID,
       R.CONTRACT_SERIAL,
       R.REQUEST_TYPE_ID,
       TP.REQUEST_TYPE_NAME,
       ST.STATUS_CODE STATUS,
       R.REQUEST_DATE,

       /* ============================================================
          MERCHANT
          ============================================================ */
       RAWTOHEX(M.MERCHANT_ID) AS MERCHANT_ID,
       M.MERCHANT_NAME_EN,
       M.CIF,
       M.BRANCH_CODE,

       /* ============================================================
          REQUEST-LEVEL ASSIGNMENTS
          ============================================================ */
       RAWTOHEX(R.RM_ID) AS RM_ID,
       RM.RM_NAME AS RM_NAME,

       RAWTOHEX(R.TEAM_LEADER_ID) AS TEAM_LEADER_ID,
       TL.RM_NAME AS TEAM_LEADER_NAME,

       RAWTOHEX(R.RMS_ORACLE_ID) AS RMS_ORACLE_ID,
       RMS.RM_NAME AS RMS_ORACLE_NAME,

       /* ============================================================
          TERMINAL COUNTS
          ============================================================ */
       SUM(
           CASE
               WHEN P.TERMINAL_TYPE_ID = 1 THEN 1
               ELSE 0
           END
       ) AS POS_COUNT,

       SUM(
           CASE
               WHEN P.TERMINAL_TYPE_ID = 2 THEN 1
               ELSE 0
           END
       ) AS POC_COUNT,

       SUM(
           CASE
               WHEN P.TERMINAL_TYPE_ID = 3 THEN 1
               ELSE 0
           END
       ) AS UPG_COUNT

FROM TALY_BO_REP.MMS_ONBOARDING_REQUEST R

JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_MERCHANT M
     ON M.MERCHANT_ID = R.MERCHANT_ID
    AND M.IS_DELETED = 0

/* ================================================================
   RM
   ================================================================= */
LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_RMS RM
     ON RM.RM_ID = R.RM_ID

/* ================================================================
   TEAM LEADER
   ================================================================= */
LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_RMS TL
     ON TL.RM_ID = R.TEAM_LEADER_ID

/* ================================================================
   RMS ORACLE
   ================================================================= */
LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_RMS RMS
     ON RMS.RM_ID = R.RMS_ORACLE_ID

/* ================================================================
   TERMINALS
   ================================================================= */
LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_TERMINAL T
     ON T.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID
    AND T.IS_DELETED = 0

LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_TERMINAL_TYPE P
     ON P.TERMINAL_TYPE_ID = T.TERMINAL_TYPE_ID
    AND P.ACTIVE_FLAG = 1

/* ================================================================
   REQUEST TYPE
   ================================================================= */
LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_REQUEST_TYPE TP
     ON TP.REQUEST_TYPE_ID = R.REQUEST_TYPE_ID
left join MMS_REQUEST_STATUS st on st.STATUS_ID = r.STATUS_ID 
WHERE R.IS_DELETED = 0

GROUP BY
       R.REQUEST_ID,
       R.CONTRACT_SERIAL,
       R.REQUEST_TYPE_ID,
       TP.REQUEST_TYPE_NAME,
       /* Formatted on 9/21/2026 3:57:12 PM (QP5 v5.362) */
st.STATUS_CODE,
       R.REQUEST_DATE,

       M.MERCHANT_ID,
       M.MERCHANT_NAME_EN,
       M.CIF,
       M.BRANCH_CODE,

       R.RM_ID,
       RM.RM_NAME,

       R.TEAM_LEADER_ID,
       TL.RM_NAME,

       R.RMS_ORACLE_ID,
       RMS.RM_NAME,

       R.CREATED_AT

ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC
